narrative.overview: The visual system treats Muruj Compound Smouha's 182-feddan master-planned urban community as an authoritative Alexandrian architectural monograph and private sales pavilion. Rather than relying on generic real-estate portal card-clutter, the interface combines sun-warmed Alexandrian limestone (#F6F3EC) and travertine (#EBE5D8) surfaces with deep Mediterranean cypress forest (#0D3B2E) structural anchors and burnished bronze (#B8864B) accents derived directly from the official AlForat Development identity.
keyCharacteristics: Warm Alexandrian limestone and travertine stone surfaces paired with deep cypress forest conversion desks.
Crisp 1px architectural drafting hairlines (#D8D0C1) organizing key project metrics into scannable ledgers.
Bilingual Cairo typography with tabular-nums for unit areas (m²), down-payment percentages, and E.164 phone numbers.
Self-contained vector country flags and Lucide stroke-consistent (1.75px) architectural iconography.

rules.name: The Tinted-Ink Rule
rules.body: Secondary and muted text on warm stone or dark cypress surfaces is always tinted from the pine/champagne hue family (#263B34, #475E56, #DEC094), never neutral gray.

rules.name: The Conversion Desk Contrast Rule
rules.body: While content sections rest on calm limestone and travertine grounds, the Lead Registration Form owns a dedicated deep cypress (#0D3B2E) pavilion with a burnished bronze (#B8864B) submit button so the primary conversion action is unmistakable.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Headings (<h1>–<h3>) never carry an eyebrow or kicker label above them; the heading itself leads the section with generous top spacing.

rules.name: The Tabular Measurement Rule
rules.body: Every area (106 م²–479 م²), percentage (10%, 15%, 20%), distance (3.2 كم), and phone number uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

dos: Do keep the Hero section first and the Lead Form immediately second on the Home page.
Do validate phone numbers per country via libphonenumber-js and format them in full E.164 format (+20...).
Do set explicit width and height attributes on every element to maintain zero Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS).
Do use only verified unit areas (106 م²–479 م²), villa types (V1–V4), landmarks, and payment plans from the 4 official sources.
donts: Don't place kicker or eyebrow labels above headings (<h1>, <h2>, <h3>).
Don't invent unit prices, areas, or delivery dates not present in the sources.
Don't expose third-party broker logos, phone numbers, or external hotlinked images.
Don't fire the Google Ads conversion event on /thank-you unless sessionStorage confirms a real form submission on that visit.
